title: 第7章 拜入武馆第8章 蛰龙吐纳法和大泼风刀
slug: 两界我的金手指有点无敌
content_zh:
慕璃脸上也是露出一丝喜色，沉声道：“慕盼，别咋咋呼呼的，放开人家。”
她年纪也不大，最多二十岁，容貌俏丽不比妹妹差，身姿凹凸有致，前凸后翘，双腿修长，胸前把衣服撑的鼓鼓的。
“哦。”慕盼轻哦一声放开顾铮。
慕璃抱拳道：“这位公子可是要学武？请跟我进来吧。”
顾铮跟在她身后走进武馆，似是不经意道：“我听说去年慕馆主杀死了一只僵尸？”
“正好路过，既然练武之人，当心怀正义之心，既看到僵尸作祟，自然不会袖手旁观。”慕璃轻描淡写道。
慕盼也连忙道：“公子，我们青云武馆开了二十年了，我姐姐学到了我父亲的全部本事，只要你在武馆学武，不久的将来也能和我姐姐一样有把僵尸大卸八块的实力。”
她一边说话，一边使劲对姐姐使眼色，示意不要放跑了这只肥羊。
顾铮点点头：“希望如此，学费不是问题。”
“好说好说！”
慕盼美眸放光。
到了武馆中，慕璃开口道：“我们武馆学武有三档学费，一个月一两银子，半年五两银子，一年十两银子，不知道公子想学多久？”
价格倒是不贵，顾铮已经清楚这个世界的物价，普通人一年的收入大约二十两。
从学费上看，青云武馆就不是普通人家承担得起的，没几个人会把收入的一半用来学武。
会来青云武馆习武的属于那种家里有点小钱，但又不是特别富裕的人。
顾铮摇摇头：“这三个我都不想选。”
慕璃一脸疑惑：“那公子你想……”
“我想学真本事。”
“我们武馆教的都是真本事。”
顾铮才不相信给几两银子的学费就能学到真本事。

就算师徒之间父要对徒弟留一手，况且是开武馆，这可是一门养家糊口的东西，对开武馆的人来说，真传授真本事，多教会一个人，多一个人抢饭碗。
尤其是独门武功，最核心精华所在，更是轻易不会传授。
就算是在现代，顾铮都听过“功夫教全盘，点寸不轻传”、“传拳不传步，传步打师父”这些广为流传的话。
所以他可以肯定，这青云武馆传授普通弟子的多是套路、架子，或许其中有真本事，可到底是几分真本事？
两分？
三分？
还是五分？
顾铮想学的是十分。
顾铮摇摇头：“我的意思是慕馆主你会多少，我就要学多少，不藏私的那种。还是之前那句话，我不差钱，钱不是问题。”
“真的吗？”
慕盼小财迷美眸亮的可怕，娇声：“你能给多少钱？至少一百两！不，一年至少要两百两！姐姐，快答应吧，公子诚意都这么足了。”
慕璃柳眉微皱，没有说话。
“陈叔。”
“欸。”
陈叔放下手上的木盒，取下背着的两个木盒。
“这是什么？”慕璃扫视了一眼三个木盒。
顾铮微微一笑：“这是我的拜师礼。五百两，一把刀，一把剑。”
他一一打开木盒，第一个木盒里面躺着五百两银票，第二个第三个木盒里面装着一把横刀，一把剑。
“公子真大方啊！”
content_en:
Mu Li also showed a hint of joy on her face, and said in a deep voice: "Mu Pan, stop whining and let go."
She is not too old, at most twenty years old. She is as pretty as her younger sister, with a curvy figure, bulging forward and backward, slender legs, and her chest is bulging out from her clothes.
"Oh." Mu Pan let go of Gu Zheng with a light voice.
Mu Li cupped her fists and said, "This young master wants to learn martial arts? Please come in with me."
Gu Zheng followed her into the martial arts gym and said casually, "I heard that the master of the gym killed a zombie last year?"
"I happened to be passing by. Since martial arts practitioners should have a righteous heart, they will naturally not stand idly by when they see zombies causing trouble." Mu Li wrote lightly.
Mu Pan also said quickly: "Sir, our Qingyun Martial Arts School has been open for 20 years. My sister has learned all the skills of my father. As long as you learn martial arts in the martial arts school, in the near future you will be as capable as my sister of cutting zombies into pieces."
As she spoke, she winked at her sister, signaling not to let the fat sheep run away.
Gu Zheng nodded: "I hope so, tuition is not a problem."
"Easy to say, easy to say!"
Mu Pan's beautiful eyes shined.
When they arrived at the martial arts hall, Mu Li said, "There are three levels of tuition for learning martial arts in our martial arts hall, one tael of silver a month, five taels of silver for half a year, and ten taels of silver a year. I wonder how long you want to study, sir?"
The price is not expensive. Gu Zheng already knows the prices in this world. The average person's annual income is about twenty taels.
From the perspective of tuition fees, Qingyun Martial Arts School is not affordable for ordinary people, and few people will spend half of their income on learning martial arts.
Those who come to Qingyun Martial Arts Hall to practice martial arts belong to the kind of people whose families have a little money but are not particularly wealthy.
Gu Zheng shook his head: "I don't want to choose any of these three."
Mu Li looked puzzled: "Master, what do you want..."
"I want to learn real skills."
"What we teach in our martial arts school are all real skills."
Gu Zhengcai didn't believe that he could learn real skills for just a few taels of silver in tuition.
Even if the father has to keep a hand in the apprenticeship, and he is opening a martial arts gym, it is a way to support his family. For those who open a martial arts gym, if they really teach the true skills, one more person will be taught, and one more person will grab their job.
Especially the core essence of unique martial arts cannot be taught easily.
Even in modern times, Gu Zheng has heard the widely circulated sayings such as "Kung Fu is taught comprehensively, and every inch is passed lightly" and "Pass the fists but not the steps, and use the steps to beat the master."
So he can be sure that most of what Qingyun Martial Arts School teaches ordinary disciples are routines and airs. Maybe there is real ability in it, but how much real ability is it?
Two points?
Three points?
Or five points?
What Gu Zheng wanted to learn was ten points.
Gu Zheng shook his head: "What I mean is that I will learn as much as you know, Master Mu, without hiding anything. As I said before, I am not short of money, money is not a problem."
"Really?"
Mu Pan Xiao Cai Mi's beautiful eyes were terrifyingly bright, and she said softly: "How much money can you give? At least one hundred taels! No, at least two hundred taels a year! Sister, please agree, the young master is so sincere."
Mu Li frowned slightly and said nothing.
"Uncle Chen."
"Eh."
Uncle Chen put down the wooden box in his hand and took down the two wooden boxes he was carrying.
"What is this?" Mu Li glanced at the three wooden boxes.
Gu Zheng smiled slightly: "This is my apprenticeship ceremony. Five hundred taels, a knife and a sword."
He opened the wooden boxes one by one. In the first wooden box lay five hundred taels of silver notes, and in the second and third wooden boxes there were a horizontal knife and a sword.
"Young Master is so generous!"
